title: Ionic liquid-based microwave-assisted extraction of chlorogenic acid from green coffee beans
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1580-1588
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00055F, Paper

Ramalakshmi Kulathooran, Subhapriya Pushparaju, Dhanapal Venkatachalam, Divyashree Jangam Seshagiri, Katyaini Panday, Jagan Mohan Rao Lingamallu
Microwave-assisted extraction utilizing a hydrophilic ionic liquid, 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium tetrafluoroborate, was employed to extract chlorogenic acid from green coffee beans employing Box–Behnken response surface methodology.
